Personal Assistant to Manager Job at ICE-TECX




        
    

        
        ICE-TECX - Our client delivers high-consequence supply and installation solutions across three essential sectors: Military Hardware, Medical Equipment, and General Procurement. We support agencies, defence forces, and healthcare institutions with reliable systems and rapid delivery.

Our capabilities span tactical hardware installations and defence infrastructure, life-saving clinical equipment and supplies, and high-volume enterprise logistics. We combine strict international compliance with direct manufacturer networks to ensure authenticity, quality, and technical readiness.

They are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Personal Assistant to Manager
     

            
    



Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Manage and maintain the Manager's schedule, including scheduling appointments, coordinating meetings, and organizing calendar priorities.
	Act as the first point of contact for internal and external communications directed to the Manager's office.
	Draft, proofread, and prepare routine correspondence, memos, executive reports, and presentation slides.
	Organize travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics for official trips and external meetings.
	Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive business data, personnel records, and executive discussions.
	Track actionable tasks, follow up on key projects, and ensure timely completion of directives assigned by the Manager.


General Qualifications


	OND, HND, or B.Sc in Business Administration, Office Management, Public Administration, Secretarial Studies, or a related field.
	2 – 4 years of proven experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Secretarial Support to senior management.
	High proficiency in MS Office Tools (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and calendar management applications.
	Exceptional organizational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.
	Excellent oral and written communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
	High degree of integrity, discretion, tact, and attention to detail.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their detailed CV in MS Word or PDF to: [email protected] using "Personal Assistant" as the subject of the email.

Note


	Any mail that does not conform to the above format shall be rejected.
	Applicants not living within the location or not willing to relocate need not apply.
	Any applicant that does not have the requisite qualification need not apply.

Influencer Marketing Manager Job at Transsion Holdings




        
    

        
        Transsion Holdings is a leading global technology company specializing in smart devices and consumer electronics. Through its renowned brands—TECNO, Infinix, itel, Oraimo, and Syinix—the company serves millions of customers across Africa and other emerging markets. We are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and developing talented professionals who are passionate about making an impact.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Influencer Marketing Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	We're looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to lead influencer strategy and campaigns across itel's product ecosystem.
	You'll drive brand awareness, engagement, and sales by building the right creator partnerships—owning campaigns from concept to results.


Job Responsibilities


	Develop and execute influencer strategies aligned with brand and product-launch goals across accessories, home appliances, and more
	Source, onboard, and build lasting relationships with influencers, creators, and agencies—negotiating deliverables, timelines, and compensation
	Run campaigns end-to-end: creative briefs, product seeding, content delivery, and brand-guideline compliance
	Curate content quality in partnership with design, social, and product marketing teams
	Track KPIs (reach, engagement, conversions, CPE, ROI) and turn insights into optimization recommendations
	Manage budgets and negotiate cost-effective partnerships
	Stay ahead of competitor activity, emerging creators, and platform trends
	Collaborate across Product Marketing, Digital, PR, E-commerce, and Sales to support launches, campaigns, and events


Job Requirements


	Proven experience in influencer or social media marketing
	Strong network of creators, agencies, and talent managers
	Sharp eye for content quality and brand storytelling
	Data-driven approach to campaign performance and budgeting
	Excellent negotiation, communication, and project-management skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] and cc: [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of the mail.

title: Administrative Assistant Job at Future Moves Recruitment Agency
content:
Future Moves Recruitment Agency (FMR Agency) is an End to end HR Company in Nigeria placing quality candidates to quality Companies alongside other services. This time, our client in the Fintechindustry is looking for a well experienced and competent Administrative assistant.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative Assistant

Job Location: Aba, Abia
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organized and tech-savvy Administrative Assistant to support daily administrative operations, data management, reporting, and project coordination.
	The ideal candidate should have experience working in a software, financial services, fintech, digital, telecommunications, or other technology-driven environment, with strong hands-on proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data management.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage and maintain accurate company records, databases, and administrative documentation.
	Handle and organize large volumes of data using Microsoft Excel.
	Prepare basic reports, summaries, and data analysis for management.
	Use Excel functions such as VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, sorting, filtering, and basic formulas.
	Track projects, tasks, deadlines, and deliverables to ensure timely completion.
	Assist with project coordination and follow up with relevant team members.
	Prepare presentations, reports, spreadsheets, and other business documents.
	Support scheduling, meetings, correspondence, and general administrative activities.
	Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems.
	Monitor and update project and operational trackers.
	Provide administrative and data support to different departments as required.


Requirements


	2 – 4 years’ experience in an administrative, operations, project coordination, or data-related role.
	Candidates from software, financial services/fintech, digital, telecommunications, or other technology-driven environments are highly preferred.
	Strong hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, basic formulas, data cleaning, and reporting.
	Experience with data management, project tracking, and basic reporting.
	Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and follow up effectively.
	Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with digital/project management tools is an advantage.


Salary
N200,000 -N250,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their applications to: [email protected] with the Job Position as subject of the mail.    

    

        Click here to Apply

Job Position: Accounts Assistant

Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Assist in day-to-day accounting transactions, including recording petty cash, invoices, and receipts.
	Maintain accurate financial records, general ledgers, and digital filing systems for all financial documentation.
	Support the senior accounting team with monthly bank reconciliations and account balance verification.
	Assist in preparing payroll details, tracking staff expenses, and filing routine statutory tax returns (PAYE, VAT, WHT).
	Process supplier payments and follow up on outstanding client receivables under supervision.

	OND, NCE, or B.Sc/HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Influencer Marketing Manager Job at Transsion Holdings




        
    

        
        Transsion Holdings is a leading global technology company specializing in smart devices and consumer electronics. Through its renowned brands—TECNO, Infinix, itel, Oraimo, and Syinix—the company serves millions of customers across Africa and other emerging markets. We are committed to innovation, operational excellence, and developing talented professionals who are passionate about making an impact.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Influencer Marketing Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	We're looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to lead influencer strategy and campaigns across itel's product ecosystem.
	You'll drive brand awareness, engagement, and sales by building the right creator partnerships—owning campaigns from concept to results.


Job Responsibilities


	Develop and execute influencer strategies aligned with brand and product-launch goals across accessories, home appliances, and more
	Source, onboard, and build lasting relationships with influencers, creators, and agencies—negotiating deliverables, timelines, and compensation
	Run campaigns end-to-end: creative briefs, product seeding, content delivery, and brand-guideline compliance
	Curate content quality in partnership with design, social, and product marketing teams
	Track KPIs (reach, engagement, conversions, CPE, ROI) and turn insights into optimization recommendations
	Manage budgets and negotiate cost-effective partnerships
	Stay ahead of competitor activity, emerging creators, and platform trends
	Collaborate across Product Marketing, Digital, PR, E-commerce, and Sales to support launches, campaigns, and events


Job Requirements


	Proven experience in influencer or social media marketing
	Strong network of creators, agencies, and talent managers
	Sharp eye for content quality and brand storytelling
	Data-driven approach to campaign performance and budgeting
	Excellent negotiation, communication, and project-management skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] and cc: [email protected] using the Job Position as subject of the mail.
